item.title: Pre-match: Sadler looking for upturn in momentum ahead of weekend clash
item.description: Head Coach Mat Sadler has said how he’s looking for an upturn in momentum from his squad this weekend as Walsall continue with League Two action, this time on the road against local rivals Shrewsbury Town. The game is at the earlier time of 12:30pm and will be broadcasted live on Sky Sports+. item.title: Gary Waddock departs for Wealdstone
item.description: We can confirm that Assistant Head Coach Gary Waddock has departed the club to join National League side Wealdstone as their new Manager. Gary joined the Saddlers in June 2023 and has been a key part of Mat Sadler's backroom staff ever since, providing invaluable guidance and experience along the way and showcasing his knowledge of the game in abundance. item.title: Match Report: Shrewsbury Town 1-2 Walsall
item.description: Walsall secured victory for the first time since the middle of January as a brace from Priestley Farquharson helped see off an in-form Shrewsbury Town side at Croud Meadow. The Saddlers opened the scoring through Farquharson before the Shrews levelled on the brink of half time, but the defender grabbed a brace after the interval, handing an important three points to the Saddlers. item.title: Match Report: Lichfield City 2-0 Walsall Women
item.description: Walsall Women fell to a 2-0 defeat to Lichfield City Women at the Trade Tyre Community Stadium on Sunday afternoon. Courtney Dilger’s powerful strike early on in the second half and Skye Wright’s finish from a free-kick sealed the victory for the hosts, despite the Saddlers’ valiant performance. The defeat was Walsall’s first since early October, as their 11-match unbeaten run came to an end against a West Midlands Regional Women’s Football League Division One North table-topping Lichfield. item.title: New Head of Academy Coach Development appointed
item.description: We are pleased to welcome a new member to the team within the Walsall FC Academy, with Michael Flannery joining us as our new Head of Academy Coach Development. Michael, who undertook an Hons BSc in Football Business & Coaching followed by a MSc in Coaching & Analysis, has an extensive background in football with over 15 years of coaching experience, with his most recent role at Accrington Stanley as their Head of Academy Coach & Player Development.
